div.head: Claudia Laaber’s talk at Charles University
div.p: 29th September – 1st October 2022: PhD student Claudia Laaber gives a presentation titled “Theoretical and Methodological Considerations for the Study of “Language Attitudes” by the example of Bedouin Arabic Dialects” at the Linguistics conference hosted by Charles University in Prague.
